tagline: Ready to Move | 16-Acre Community | Wakad, Pune
overview: Western Avenue is a completed 16-acre residential community by Kolte-Patil Developers in Wakad, Pune, offering 2 and 3 bedroom homes across a master-planned layout. The project is built around 30+ lifestyle amenities including a clubhouse, swimming pool with a children's section, an amphitheatre and landscaped gardens, close to the Mumbai-Pune Expressway and Hinjawadi IT Park.

title: Yashwin Urbo Centro
hero_caption: Yashwin Urbo Centro, Wakad, Pune
tagline: Under Construction | 8.5-Acre Township | 14 Towers | Wakad, Pune
overview: Yashwin Urbo Centro is an 8.5-acre high-rise residential township by Vilas Javdekar Developers near Indira College on NH48, Wakad, Pune, spread across 14 towers with 2, 3 and 4 BHK homes starting around Rs 80 Lakh. Completion is slated for December 2027.
